title: Edge Telemetry Layer: An Open-Source Embedded Real-Time Telemetry and Hardware-in-the-Loop Architecture for CAN and OBD-II with Formal MBSE Verification
description: An open-source embedded edge telemetry architecture for automotive CAN and OBD-II diagnostics. Features an asynchronous memory-safe firmware for ESP32-S3 in no_std Rust (Embassy RTOS), a C++ Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) ECU emulator, reproducible bench datasets (FAT32 SD and MQTT), and full Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) formal specifications in NASA FRET, SAE AS5506B AADL (OSATE), and CAvA evolution analysis.
